_comment: claude CLI settings for the headless tick. The PreToolUse hook is the mechanical order-authorization guard (decision D5): it runs order_guard.py before every order/cancel tool and DENIES any ref_id the Python plan did not reserve in the ledger. The matcher is a substring/regex over the tool name, so it also matches the mcp__robinhood-trading__ prefixed names. Fails CLOSED on error.
